description: Proposal of Application Notice by Apatura DC Project 11 Ltd for an AI data centre campus with a 200MW demand utility capacity with car parking, landscaping, roads, access and associated works, at Land 300 Metres North Of 50 Research Avenue North, Riccarton. The forthcoming application is intended as a full application treated as a national development (subject to demonstrating 'green data centre' status under NPF4 Digital Fibre Network designation).
decision_notes: PAN noted by the Development Management Sub-Committee on 25 March 2026; committee papers set out key issues (Green Belt/Env 18 and NPF4 policy 8, 'green data centre' demonstration, climate/nature policies, heritage, Gogar Special Landscape Area, residential amenity, transport) and an extensive list of expected supporting documents. APRS records the PAN as approved on 1 August (its submission date).

description: EIA Screening Opinion for construction of a data centre campus at Wester Hermiston.
decision_notes: The council committee paper/site history records determination on 7 July 2025; the PlanIt mirror gives 4 July. This record uses the primary council date and preserves the discrepancy rather than silently reconciling it. EIA was recorded as not required at that stage.

description: Second EIA Screening Opinion request for proposed construction of a data centre campus (re-screening).
decision_notes: Recorded as 'under consideration' in the council's 25 March 2026 committee paper. APRS ('info last checked 23 Feb 2026') described the proposal as being re-screened by the council. The official council portal records a decision of EIA Not Required issued on 6 May 2026. This remains the historical council screening outcome; Scottish Ministers later directed on 17 August 2026 that EIA is required, recorded separately as DPEA case EIA-230-002.

description: Third-party request for a Scottish Ministers' Environmental Impact Assessment screening direction for the 200 MW Wester Hermiston Data Centre Campus, linked to City of Edinburgh Council reference 25/05576/SCR.
decision_notes: DPEA records the case as decision issued. Consideration concluded on 17 August 2026 with a direction that an EIA is required. This later ministerial direction supersedes the practical effect of the council's no-EIA opinion without erasing that historical local decision.
